# AI Programmer

> A free MCP dev shell for AI agents on Windows: files, shells, git, WSL, and sessions. Written in Rust.

- Publisher: AIWander
- Platform: Windows
- Pricing: not published

## Two repositories, two jobs
- [Programmer-Wander](https://github.com/AIWander/Programmer-Wander) - the MCP server itself. Holds every release and every downloadable binary.
- [aiprogrammer](https://github.com/AIWander/aiprogrammer) - skills, guard hooks, and plugin profiles, plus the source for this site. No releases by design.

## Download
- [Releases](https://github.com/AIWander/Programmer-Wander/releases) - current public release is v0.2.0-alpha. A corrected successor is in progress and is not published yet.

## Notes
- Runs locally. Reads and writes the user own files and runs the user own commands, only when invoked.
- Bring your own AI: works with any stdio MCP client. No model key is requested.
